scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Mantis?
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
你獵殺夠50只螳螂了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放棄

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
嗯，你好像還沒獵殺夠50只。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Remember, I need help hunting Mantis so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
記住，我需要你幫忙獵殺螳螂，去殺夠50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
確定要放棄狩獵嗎？
目前的任務進度都會清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
好吧，改變主意了就回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Please kill 50 Mantis in order to make this a Place were people can go to and gather Experience.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
請獵殺50只螳螂，好讓大家能在這裡練級。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
真厲害，這麼快就完成了！

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Oh great!
You are here to help me right?
If not, i don't know what to do with the Monsters in this Place!
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
太好了！
你是來幫我的吧？
不然真不知道該拿這裡的魔物怎麼辦！

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Great! I knew the moment i saw you that i can count on you!
I need you to reduce the Amount of Monsters which are currently rampaging on this Map!
There are to many Mantis around, which makes it impossible for the lower level players to gain good experience here.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
太好了，一看你就知道靠得住！
幫我減少這張地圖上肆虐的魔物吧！
螳螂實在太多，低等級玩家根本沒法在這裡好好練級。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
So, would you still like to help me?
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
那麼，你還願意幫我嗎？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Thank you for your great help with the Mantis!
Currently the Situation is stable and i'm not in need of your help anymore to kill them.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
謝謝你幫忙對付螳螂！
目前情況已經穩定，暫時不用再幫忙獵殺了。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Kill 50 of those Mantis and let me know when you're done. I will reward you for your efforts.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
去獵殺50只螳螂，完成後回來告訴我。
我會給你報酬。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
改變主意了就回來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
改變主意了就回來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Oh boy, Oh boy!
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
天哪，天哪！

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Sorry I can't talk right now I am in a world of pain here, these darn Mantis are going to kill me.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究員]
抱歉，顧不上說話了，我正受苦呢，這些該死的螳螂快把我逼死了。
